review_kind: Codex AI bounded independent N700 zero-cost future-notice peer
status: Four precise future wording/predicate refinements; originals unchanged, no current deployment/billing/English acceptance
supported: Artifact labels all13 notices future/unapproved/unapplied and records owner billing verification/deployment/managed implementation false.
ZC02–ZC04 account-free promises are gated on actual implemented hosted selection/typed summary/explicit chat context, not copied over current user-owned CLI.
ZC05/ZC07 require authoritative quota refusal; ZC06/ZC08 require actual permitted queue and disclose removal cannot undo earlier transmission/publication.
ZC09 correctly treats indeterminate acceptance as neither filed nor proof nothing sent, requiring request reconciliation before retry. No false cancellation or future-filing guarantee.
Public reporting remains independent of AI quota with its own limits; zero cost is not unlimited service, zero retention or payload/network anonymity.
ZC10/ZC11 disabled-route predicates and ZC13 explicit CLI selection preserve existing unrelated user configuration and separate account/transport/billing terms.

precise_fixes.finding: Only after verification can read as a one-time prerequisite; stale or changed configuration must disable route, as ZC10 already anticipates.
precise_fixes.precise_future_text: This managed reporting and hosted AI route is available only while its current zero-cost configuration remains verified. It must not purchase credits, upgrade a plan or use a paid fallback. Free limits can make requests unavailable; free access is not unlimited or guaranteed indefinitely.
precise_fixes.required_proof: Actual current plan/model/resource checks and declared verification validity; stale/failed/incompatible verification leaves managed routes disabled. This is not current deployment or perpetual billing certification.

precise_fixes.kind: mandatory managed boundary, not automatic-only billing prohibition
precise_fixes.finding: ZC05 and ZC10 qualify paid selection/upgrade with automatically; ZC12 title/text says no automatic charges. The guide forbids buying managed plans/credits/hosting/domains or paid fallback, not only unattended changes. Separate explicitly selected CLI accounts may still have their own terms.

precise_edits.ZC05: Replace "spaCR will not buy credits, upgrade a plan or select paid inference automatically." with "The managed route must not buy credits, upgrade a plan or select paid inference."
precise_edits.ZC10: Replace "spaCR will not select a paid replacement or upgrade a plan automatically." with "The managed route must not select a paid replacement or upgrade a plan."
precise_edits.ZC12_text: The managed route is available only while its current zero-cost configuration is verified. When free capacity is exhausted, it refuses work or queues it only if the disclosed storage and retry policy permits queuing. It must not buy credits, upgrade plans, purchase hosting or domains, or invoke a paid fallback. Existing CLI providers use their own accounts and terms and are not part of this managed-route commitment.

precise_fixes.required_proof: Managed route refuses incompatible paid configuration regardless of user-facing confirmation; no paid resources/credits/domain/GPU rental/fallback/plan upgrades. Do not forbid explicit user choice of separately configured CLI, and do not claim guarantee for arbitrary user accounts.
precise_fixes.not_changed: ZC09 already says no switch to paid service/plan upgrade without automatic-only qualification. ZC13 automatic-fallback prohibition is appropriate; keep explicit user-owned CLI option separate.

precise_fixes.kind: make permission to queue explicit in general future notices
precise_fixes.finding: General queue-or-refuse statements are conditional in the overall artifact, but ZC03/ZC04 per-notice proof predicates do not explicitly require permitted bounded queue. Queued outcome must not be promised by capacity exhaustion alone.
precise_fixes.precise_clause: When free capacity is unavailable, the request is refused or, only if the disclosed storage and retry policy permits it, queued.
precise_fixes.required_proof: Append to ZC03/ZC04 display predicates: actual permitted bounded queue, disclosed stored content/location/retention/deletion and retry limits, valid purpose-specific consent, atomic request identity and reconciliation. Otherwise refuse. General policy notice is not actual queued-status acknowledgment.
precise_fixes.preserve: ZC06/ZC08 remain reserved for actual recorded queues; explicit refusal ZC05/ZC07 and unknown outcome ZC09 stay separate.

precise_fixes.finding: Separate destinations and limits are stated, and global requirements mention opt-outs, but no notice directly says public/cloud consent and settings are independent. Combined managed-route disclosure must not become shared blanket consent.
precise_fixes.precise_future_text: Public reporting and cloud AI have separate settings and data disclosures. Choosing a cloud diagnosis or chat does not by itself authorize public filing. Approving a public report does not by itself authorize a cloud AI request. You can turn each off independently.
precise_fixes.required_proof: Actual separate settings/disclosures/consent and no network when each purpose disabled; valid new hosted request or explicit reuse distinction; account-free technical diagnosis and sensitive freeform chat remain separate payloads. State UI cancellation/timeout limits truthfully.
precise_fixes.approval_scope: Optional additional future notice only; Home must approve exact English and implementation before use.

unknown_outcome_qualification: Keep ZC09 unchanged for report transport ambiguity; never replace it with authoritative refusal/queue language until request identity reconciled. Likewise a future ambiguous AI request cannot be labelled quota-refused/no-inference without corresponding evidence; no new AI status claimed here.
